label: Orders
caption: FIELDS, TROY V. COLORADO
text: The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted. The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Court of Appeals of Colorado for further consideration in light of Erlinger v. United States, 602 U. S. 821 (2024).
